battle.name: 顏宣政起義
battle.brief: 隋煬帝大業十一年（615）正月，齊郡鄉民領袖顏宣政聚眾起事，隋廷遣武賁郎將高毦率郡兵進剿，擊潰叛眾，擄男女數千人。卡面為前七世紀希臘科林斯青銅盔，與此役相隔一千二百餘年，未曾出現在東亞戰場，僅作跨時代對照。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場衝突是隋朝中央與齊郡鄉里聚眾之間的一場鎮壓戰，交戰雙方規模都很小，卻折射出隋末的結構性問題。叛方是齊郡（隋代治歷城縣，即今山東濟南一帶）的鄉里百姓，首領為當地起義領袖顏宣政；他們沒有常設編制，沒有可考的軍號與官爵，靠里社鄰里間的招呼迅速聚合，以屯聚鄉野、威脅縣城為主要手段，兵器多為自帶的農具與竹木杆兵。官軍一方是隋朝在齊郡及鄰郡的鎮壓部隊：由郡府與州縣調集的郡兵、縣兵為主，配少量州級將校直轄的宿衛兵骨幹，指揮官為武賁郎將高毦。命令來自遠在涿郡前線的隋煬帝，郡內的實際防務則由齊郡與鄰郡的長吏、縣令分頭承擔。值得注意的是，隋廷在遼東用兵正酣，能投入山東的中央精兵有限，鎮壓叛亂主要依靠地方郡兵；而這批郡兵裝備陳舊、訓練鬆散，多屬臨時徵發的鄉兵，遠非徵發高句麗時的精銳。
countriesEn: This was a suppression fight between the Sui central government and a rural rising in the commandery of Qi, small in scale on both sides yet revealing the structural weakness of the late Sui. On the rebel side were the villagers of Qi commandery — governed in Sui times from Licheng county, in today's Jinan, Shandong — led by the local insurgent Yan Xuanzheng. They had no standing establishment, no recorded unit titles and no official ranks, and they came together quickly through neighbourhood networks, relying on holding the countryside and threatening county seats; their weapons were largely farming tools and wooden or bamboo pole weapons carried in by the men themselves. On the government side stood the Sui force raised in Qi and the neighbouring commanderies: mostly commandery and county levies mustered by the local administration, with a small core of imperial guards under a commandery-level general, and the command in the hands of Gao Cui, commander of the Wu-bi Lang-jiang. The order came from Emperor Yang of Sui himself, who was at that moment on the northern front at Zhuojun, while the actual defence of the region fell to the senior officials and magistrates of Qi and its neighbours. It is worth noting that with the bulk of the Sui army committed in Liaodong, only a limited number of central troops could be spared for Shandong, so suppression was entrusted to local levies — poorly equipped, loosely trained and largely conscripted villagers, nothing like the elite troops raised for the Goguryeo campaigns.
people: 史籍對顏宣政的記載極少，能確定的只有兩點：他籍貫齊郡，是大業十一年正月聚眾起義的發動者；事後他本人下落不明，無論生擒或陣亡，均未見記載。武賁郎將高毦是平叛的主將，他率軍自郡城方向出擊，把聚集起來的叛眾擊散並追捕潰散之眾，戰後以「擄男女數千人」結案。《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都只以寥寥數語記此事，沒有留下陣亡名單、官軍兵數或任何損耗數。齊郡的郡守、刺史與歷城等縣的縣令姓名，在相關記載中同樣缺名，只能確認郡治與縣城一度受威脅、郡兵奉調集結。放在更長的時段裏看，這場起義夾在隋煬帝第三次征高句麗的前後：前方宇文述等將領在平壤城下久攻不下、消耗兵力，河北山東則徵發不息；前此已有王薄於長山聚眾起義，隋廷懸賞購求、搜捕牽連山東各郡。前線名將張須陀當時正在河北清剿流民群，翌年正月戰死於盧家塞，其後更無可靠大將可以調回山東收拾殘局。
peopleEn: The records about Yan Xuanzheng himself are extremely thin, and only two points can be stated with certainty: that he was a native of Qi commandery and the man who set the rising in motion in the first month of the eleventh year of Daye; and that his fate afterwards is unknown, with no record of his being taken alive or killed in the fighting, and no later mention of him in any biography. Gao Cui, the Wu-bi Lang-jiang who commanded the suppression, marched out with troops from the direction of the commandery seat, scattered the assembled rebels and hunted down those who fled, and the affair was closed officially on the strength of the reported capture of several thousand men and women. Both the Book of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance describe the episode in only a few lines, leaving no casualty lists, no figures for the government force and no figures for losses. The names of Qi's commandery governor and its inspector, and of the magistrates of Licheng and the other counties, are likewise missing; all that can be confirmed is that the commandery seat and the county towns were for a time threatened and that the commandery levies were mustered. On the wider stage the rising sits between Emperor Yang's third campaign against Goguryeo: in the front line generals such as Yuwen Shu had spent months before Pyongyang without taking the city, while Hebei and Shandong laboured under repeated levies; earlier, Wang Bo had raised men at Changshan in Shandong, and the Sui court had posted rewards for his capture, with the manhunt spreading into the counties of Shandong. The famous general Zhang Xutuo was at that moment grinding up refugee bands in Hebei and was killed at Lujiasei in the first month of the following year; no dependable general was left to be recalled to Shandong afterwards.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是前七世紀希臘的產物：全正面開眼、只留一道狹窄視縫觀敵的青銅頭盔，設計前提是密集方陣中的正面搏鬥，戴盔者靠整排頭盔的視線縫保持陣形一致。它與隋朝山東鄉里之間的戰爭沒有任何裝備上的關係，也不能出現在 615 年的戰場上：兩者相隔約一千二百六十年，歐亞東西兩端的冶金、護具與兵制發展路徑並無交集。卡面在此只是本站用來對照「以整齊頭盔維持方陣」這一軍事原理的跨時代標本。真正上陣的是隋軍的常備武備：護身以皮甲、札甲為主，鐵鎧多配給騎兵與軍官，頭戴皮兜鍪或鐵兜鍪，作戰用橫刀、長槊與方天戟，弓以角弓、竹木弓為主，弩有臂弩、蹶張弩與常平弩等數種，重型弩機列於軍陣之後，攻城另備投石機、巢車與雲梯，輜重依靠牛車與馬匹輸送，旗鼓甲仗齊整。叛方沒有制式裝備，靠的是木杆矛、竹槍、繩索、鐮斧與農具，護身只有皮甲或布衣，靠人數、齊整與地勢取勝，糧食則多取自里正供送的存糧。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a seventh-century BCE Greek product: a bronze helmet closed over the whole face with only a narrow viewing slit, designed for close fighting in a dense phalanx, the wearer keeping the line in step through the aligned sight-slots of the rank. It has no equipment relationship whatsoever to the war between Sui and the villagers of Shandong and could not have been present on a battlefield in 615: the two are separated by roughly twelve hundred and sixty years, and the metallurgical, armouring and military-organisational paths of the two ends of Eurasia never intersected. The card is used here simply as a cross-era reference for the military principle of holding a formation in line through uniform helmets. What actually went into battle were the standard Sui arms: protection was mainly leather and lamellar armour, with iron plate given mostly to cavalry and officers; troops wore leather or iron caps; the cutting and thrusting weapons were the hengdao cross-sabre, the long spear and the fangtian halberd; bows were of horn or wood and bamboo, and crossbows came in several types including the single-handed, the drawn and the repeated-cocking heavy crossbow, the powerful crossbow engines being deployed behind the main line; for siege work the Sui brought stone-throwers, siege towers and scaling ladders, and supplies moved by ox-carts and pack horses, with banner, drum and accoutrement all in good order. The rebels had no regulation equipment: wooden-shafted spears, bamboo lances, ropes, sickles, axes and farm tools, with only leather armour or homespun cloth for protection, winning on numbers, rough order and ground, and drawing their grain from the stores collected by the village headmen.
tactics: 叛方的戰法是典型的地方民變模式：先在鄉里聚眾，人數不足以攻城時就屯聚於山林、陂澤與村落之間的隱蔽地帶，等待官軍離開或分散時再襲擊縣城、驅散糧車；逼近郡治時則以柴草堆塞門戶、穴地掘進、攀城而入，破城之後往往一掠而散，重新散入鄉野。齊郡北接濟水、南倚泰山餘脈，河流縱橫、澤地連片，濟北一帶又夾在齊郡與渤海郡之間，道路多為田間小徑，大隊騎兵難以展開，這是叛眾得以周旋的地理條件。官軍的處置則是典型的郡兵鎮壓：由郡府與各縣集結步卒為主力，前列布弩，槊手與射手在後，騎兵分置兩翼，主要任務不是攻殺而是包圍、驅散、追捕潰卒，最後以清剿殘部、押解俘虜收尾。高毦率軍自郡城方向推進，藉郡兵熟悉鄉里道路的優勢逐村搜捕。整場戰事的成敗關鍵不在單挑，而在能否把鬆散聚眾在同一時間壓在一處。
tacticsEn: The rebel method was that of the typical local rising: men were first gathered in the villages, and while their numbers were too small to take a walled town they would hold out in the wooded hills, the marshes and the hidden ground between settlements, waiting for the government troops to move off or to scatter before striking at the county towns and driving off the grain carts; when they closed on the commandery seat they piled brushwood against the gates, tunnelled under the walls and climbed in, and after a city fell they would plunder and scatter again, dispersing back into the countryside. Qi commandery ran from the Ji River in the north to the spurs of Mount Tai in the south, with braided waterways and wide stretches of marsh; the area north of Ji lay wedged between Qi and Bohai commanderies, and the roads were mostly field paths on which large bodies of cavalry could not operate — that was the ground on which the rebels were able to move. The government's response was the standard suppression by commandery levies: infantry mustered by the commandery office and the counties formed the core, crossbows deployed in front, spear and bow men behind them, cavalry posted on the two wings, the main task being not to kill but to encircle, to break up and to run down those who fled, the business then closing with the mopping up of stragglers and the escorting of prisoners. Gao Cui advanced from the direction of the commandery seat, using the levies' familiarity with the lanes and byways of the countryside to search village by village. The whole business turned on a single point, not on single combat but on whether the loose crowds could be compressed into one place at one time.
data: 可核對的數字不多，逐一列明：起事時間為隋大業十一年正月初五，即公元 615 年年初；參戰官軍的兵員數史無明載，僅知為武賁郎將高毦所率的郡兵與縣兵，規模屬郡級；叛眾人數史書只作「聚眾」記載，不載確數，因此不可推算；戰果的官方記錄是「擄男女數千人」。地理數據方面，齊郡治歷城縣，即今山東濟南，郡境領歷城、盂山、章丘、淄川、長山等縣，叛事發生的區域在濟水以北的郡北一帶；自歷城至京師洛陽約三百五十公里上下，軍報須循濟水、清水轉入河洛道，再自洛陽前遞涿郡行在所。作為時局背景的數字：隋煬帝征高句麗之師號稱逾百萬而糧秣僅備六十日；大業八年平壤之役後高句麗反攻涿郡，隋軍戰死者以十四五萬計；此前隋廷曾懸賞購求起於山東長山的王薄。這些數字屬全國層面的量級，與齊郡一場郡級聚眾的規模並不相同，記錄時不可混用。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and they are set out one by one. The rising began in the fifth day of the first month of the eleventh year of Daye, that is in early 615. The number of government troops is nowhere recorded; all that is known is that they were the commandery and county levies under Gao Cui, a force of commandery scale. The size of the rebel crowd is given only as a gathering of men, without a number, and cannot be calculated. The official record of the result is the capture of several thousand men and women. On geography: the seat of Qi commandery was Licheng county, in today's Jinan, Shandong; the commandery held the counties of Licheng, Yushan, Zhangqiu, Zichuan and Changshan, and the area of the rising lay north of the Ji River. From Licheng to the capital at Luoyang is about three hundred and fifty kilometres; dispatches would have to travel up the Ji and the Qingshui into the Heluo road and then on from Luoyang to the imperial camp at Zhuojun. As background figures for the wider situation: the army Emperor Yang took against Goguryeo is said to have numbered more than a million while its grain was provisioned for only sixty days; after the defeat at Pyongyang in the eighth year of Daye, Goguryeo counter-attacked at Zhuojun and the Sui losses there are put at a hundred and forty to a hundred and fifty thousand dead; and earlier the court had posted rewards for the capture of Wang Bo, who had risen at Changshan in Shandong. These are national-scale magnitudes and must not be mixed up with the size of a single commandery-level rising in Qi.
cause: 起義的直接誘因，史料沒有留下直接記載，只能從時局推斷。大業十一年（615）隋煬帝第三次大舉征高句麗，兵役、漕運與徭役同時加到北方各州縣；齊郡是山東重要的租調與丁役輸出地，郡縣官吏為完足額數而催科急迫，鄉里承受力已到極限。此前山東長山的王薄首義被隋廷懸賞緝拿，搜捕牽連郡內多家，人心浮動。與此同時，前線久攻不下、糧秣不繼的消息傳回，山東鄉里對「郡兵遠征、地方空虛」有直接感受，於是聚眾自保式的武裝反抗有了現成的榜樣。值得注意的是，這一帶在隋末此後數年確實接連出現更大規模的叛亂：河間竇建德、淮南杜伏威、太原劉武周、遼東宇文化及相繼而起。顏宣政本人此前的經歷、是否曾任吏或受過官府徵發，史料未載，其角色更接近地方起義的最初發動者，而非逐級擴大的舊軍將領。
causeEn: The immediate trigger of the rising is not recorded in the sources and can only be inferred from the situation. In the eleventh year of Daye (615) Emperor Yang launched his third great campaign against Goguryeo, and the burden of military service, river transport and corvée labour fell at the same time on the northern provinces and commanderies. Qi was an important source of grain tax and labour for Shandong, and the commandery and county officials, scrambling to make up the full quota, pressed the villages until the limit of what they could bear was reached. Before this, Wang Bo's rising at Changshan in Shandong had been answered with posted rewards and a manhunt that reached into many households of the commandery, leaving the population unsettled. At the same time news of the stalled front and the failing supplies travelled back to the east, and the villages of Shandong could see for themselves that the commandery levies were far away and the district was empty. A rising of this kind therefore had an obvious model to follow. It is worth noticing that in the following years of the late Sui the same region did see larger rebellions in succession: Dou Jiande in Hebei, Du Fuwei in the Huai valley, Liu Wuzhou at Taiyuan and Yuwen Huaji in Liaodong. Nothing is known of Yan Xuanzheng's earlier life, of whether he had ever held office or been called up by the authorities; his role looks more like that of the first man to set a local rising going than that of a former officer building on an existing force.
impact: 這場起義在軍事上是一場速戰速決的鎮壓：聚眾很快被壓散，齊郡的郡級秩序在短期內恢復，隋朝中央在山東的威信沒有受到致命打擊。但放在隋末的長時段裏看，這一役有兩層意義。第一，暴露了中央對山東河北的控制已高度依賴地方：能拿下叛亂的只有郡兵與縣兵，這批人既是鎮壓者，也是下一次徵兵時的來源，國家機器與地方武力的界線在起義與反起義的循環中被磨薄。第二，延續了山東自王薄以來的地方武裝傳統，把「以郡兵平地方叛亂」的常態化成本轉嫁給河北山東的郡縣，此後數年濟南、渤海、兗州一帶的郡兵屢徵屢疲，鄉里青壯大批脫離戶籍與田畝，軍隊與賦役的基礎同時受損。史書沒有記載顏宣政本人之後的結局，這場起義也因而成為一段沒有延續的政治實體；但它在時間上正好卡在隋朝崩潰之前的最後幾年，成為觀察隋末亂序如何在郡縣層面醞釀的一段切口。
impactEn: Militarily the rising was a quick suppression: the crowd was broken up within a short time, the commandery-level order in Qi was restored, and the authority of the Sui centre in Shandong did not suffer a mortal blow. Placed in the longer span of the late Sui, however, the episode carries two meanings. First, it shows how far central control over Shandong and Hebei had come to depend on the localities: the only troops able to end the rising were the commandery and county levies, and the same men who suppressed it were also the pool from which the next levy would be drawn, so that the boundary between the state apparatus and local military power was rubbed thin by the cycle of revolt and repression. Second, it carried on the armed tradition of local self-defence in Shandong that had begun with Wang Bo, and it made the routine cost of putting down provincial rebellions with provincial troops a permanent charge on the commanderies of Hebei and Shandong; for years afterwards the levies of Jinan, Bohai and Yanzhou were raised and exhausted repeatedly, the young men of the villages fell away in large numbers from the registers and the fields, and the base of both the army and the taxation was damaged at once. The histories do not record what became of Yan Xuanzheng himself, and for that reason this rising left no political entity behind it. Placed where it falls in time, immediately before the last few years of the Sui collapse, it remains a useful point of entry for watching how disorder in the late Sui was brewed at the level of the commandery and the county.
result: 結果是起義失敗。顏宣政所聚的叛眾被武賁郎將高毦率軍擊敗，聚眾星散，潰散之眾遭追捕搜剿，戰後官府以「擄男女數千人」作為結案數字；齊郡的縣城與郡治未失陷於叛方之手，郡兵在年內恢復對郡境的控制。顏宣政本人的去向史無明載，沒有記載他被生擒、陣亡或流亡，此後亦不見於任何傳記，此役遂以地方民變的普通案卷結案。從全局看，這次鎮壓成功並不等於隋朝恢復穩態：同年稍後，河北的竇建德勢力坐大，次年劉武周、杜伏威先後起兵，遼東的宇文化及攻破潼關，隋煬帝於 618 年在江都遇弒，隋朝三十二年的國祚在起義潮中迅速收束。若單看本役，它是一次乾淨的郡級平叛；若放進 615 至 618 這條線索裏，它標示著隋朝在地方上仍能收復局面，卻已無力再重建一套能約束所有郡縣的秩序。
resultEn: The rising failed. The rebel crowd led by Yan Xuanzheng was defeated by the troops under Gao Cui, Wu-bi Lang-jiang; the gathering scattered, those who fled were hunted down and searched for, and the official record of the outcome is the capture of several thousand men and women. The county towns and the commandery seat of Qi were not taken by the rebels, and the commandery levies regained control of the district within the year. Yan Xuanzheng's own fate is not recorded: nothing says whether he was taken alive, killed in the fighting or gone into hiding, and he is not mentioned again in any biography, so the affair was closed as an ordinary case of local revolt. In the wider view, a successful suppression did not amount to a restoration of stability: within the same year Dou Jiande's power in Hebei grew unchecked, the following year Liu Wuzhou and Du Fuwei rose in turn, Yuwen Huaji broke through Tong Pass from Liaodong, and Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu in 618, the Sui dynasty's thirty-two years of existence contracting rapidly amid the tide of rebellion. Judged on its own, this was a clean commandery-level suppression; set into the line running from 615 to 618, it marks a Sui that could still recover a situation locally but could no longer rebuild an order binding every commandery and county.
